protocol.scope: vLLM internal TP/PP direction comparison, not an absolute Prism ranking
protocol.ttft: immediately before generate to first nonempty token yield
protocol.itl: observed client token intervals; coalesced tokens share one timestamp
protocol.e2e: immediately before generate to finished RequestOutput
protocol.cold: drain then reset prefix, encoder and multimodal processor caches
protocol.hot: same images, changed question, resident prefix and encoder caches
protocol.concurrent_cold: cold at burst start; reuse within the burst is allowed
protocol.throughput_scope: finite burst including prefill and drain, not saturation
protocol.pp_encoder: only first PP stage runs vision; data mode splits TP ranks, not PP stages
